        "delete_entities"

        "order*"

        "edges*",
        "end"
      ]

        "line2*",
        "radius*"

        "attributes"

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "tolerance",
        "tag"
      ]

      "op": "mirror",

      "summary": "Mirror entities about the line p1-p2",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "keep_original"
      ]

        "target*",
        "set*"
      ]

        "target*",
        "delta",
        "base",
        "to"
      ]
    },

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "distance*",
        "side_point"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },

      "op": "purge",

      "params": [
        "kinds"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "rotate",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Rotate entities about a center point (degrees, CCW)",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "angle*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "scale",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Uniformly scale entities about a base point",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "factor*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_annotation_scale",
      "category": "annotate",

      "params": [
        "scale*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_attributes",
      "category": "block",
      "summary": "Set attribute values of block references",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "values*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_properties",
      "category": "edit",

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "layer",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "tag"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "stretch",

      "summary": "AutoCAD STRETCH with a crossing window: entities entirely inside move; LINE end points, polyline vertices and dimension definition points inside the window move; circles/arcs/text/blocks move if their center/insert point is inside",

        "window*",
        "delta*"
      ]
    },

- **没有做 AutoCAD 审核。** 没有运行 autocad_audit。
